svg.text: topic/stpa/editor/paint-time-colors - decouple colour switching from document rebuilds
BEFORE - EVERY COLOUR CHANGE REBUILDS THE DOCUMENT
AFTER - THE PALETTE RESOLVES WHEN PAINTING
text re-inserted, markers re-run, layout from scratch
O(entire document) on the EDT - seconds on large files,
caret and scroll position must be saved and restored,
far too slow for flash notifications.
Spans stay bound to palette entries
no re-attribution, no markers, no layout
O(visible viewport) - instantaneous at any document size,
editor settings still rebuild only when they must
